Description.description: This table contains records of AI use cases
Actions, tasks, or operations the proposed agent or AI solution is expected to perform on behalf of users.
Short title or name of the AI use case or proposed agent. Preserve the user-provided idea title where available.
Boundaries of what the proposed agent or AI solution should and should not do, including ownership, user groups, and operational limits.
Unique Dataverse identifier for the AI use case record. Used internally for record identity and relationships.
Primary use case category selected from the approved category choices. Must use an allowed Dataverse choice value only.
Data, systems, documents, repositories, or business applications the use case depends on or may need to access.
Concise summary of the use case, including what the AI solution is intended to do and the business context it supports.
Expanded structured definition of the use case after agent-guided clarification, including important context, assumptions, and assessment-relevant detail.
Example prompts, user requests, or conversational starters that illustrate how users may interact with the proposed agent or AI solution.
Expected business benefits, value drivers, outcomes, or improvements the use case is intended to deliver.
Expected outputs or end results produced by the AI solution, such as recommendations, summaries, actions, decisions, drafts, or workflow outcomes.
Industry or sector context for the customer or use case, where known. Use only when provided or confidently identified.
Known or potential risks, blockers, constraints, dependencies, governance concerns, data issues, or adoption challenges.
More specific use case subcategory selected from the approved subcategory choices. Must align to the selected category where applicable.
Full name of the person who submitted the usecase (this will be taken from the user that is interacting with the agent)
Email of the person who run the usecase report
High-level type of AI use case or solution pattern, selected from the configured choices.
Human-readable use case reference ID shown to users and used for recall, reporting, and follow-up.
User groups, roles, personas, or audiences impacted by or expected to use the proposed AI solution.

This table contains records of AI assessment details
Agentic Fit score indicating how strongly the use case benefits from an agentic AI approach rather than a simpler automation, app, or static assistant.
Unique Dataverse identifier for the assessment record. Used internally for record identity and relationships.
Rationale and evidence supporting the Approvals and Governance complexity score.
Complexity score for governance, approval process, operational controls, deployment constraints, or policy requirements.
Human-readable assessment reference ID shown to users and used for reporting, recall, and follow-up.
Average complexity score calculated from the individual complexity factor scores.
Average impact score calculated from the individual impact factor scores.
Rationale and evidence supporting the Cost Savings and ROI impact score.
Impact score for expected cost savings, productivity gains, efficiency improvement, or return on investment.
Date and time when the assessment was generated or recorded.
Rationale and evidence supporting the Document Quality complexity score.
Complexity score for document quality, structure, OCR needs, content variability, or extraction difficulty.
Rationale and evidence supporting the Human-in-the-Loop complexity score.
Complexity score for required human review, approvals, exception handling, supervision, or decision control.
Rationale and evidence supporting the Integrations complexity score.
Complexity score for the level of data connectivity, system integration, API dependency, or cross-system orchestration required.
Rationale and evidence supporting the Quality and Consistency impact score.
Impact score for expected improvements in quality, consistency, reliability, standardisation, or reduced variation.
Reach score representing expected usage scale, such as users, transaction volume, frequency, or breadth of business impact.
Rationale and evidence supporting the Scalability and Reach impact score.
Impact score for expected scalability and breadth of reach across users, teams, transactions, or business areas.
Rationale and evidence supporting the Security and Compliance impact score.
Impact score for expected improvement or importance related to security, compliance, control, or risk reduction.
Rationale and evidence supporting the Security Constraints complexity score.
Complexity score for privacy, PII, security, access control, compliance, or data protection constraints.
Rationale and evidence supporting the Speed and Agility impact score.
Impact score for expected improvements in speed, responsiveness, cycle time, or business agility.
